advanced.mesh_task: Advertised; native compiler/command integration in 0.79.36, current feature/property snapshot. Physical results open.

advanced.external_memory: FD/dma-buf/DRM and external semaphore/fence transports unsupported.
advanced.generation_scope: Turing/Blackwell and other unlisted chips are not admitted by the native adapter; modeled reports are not physical inventories.
